recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composite image featuring a group of four men in dark urban attire floating above a high-contrast, long-exposure night street scene saturated with warm orange light and deep blue shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Floating subjects over a grounded perspective-driven street
Warm orange street lighting contrasting with cool blue skin highlights
Large-scale display typography anchored at the bottom foreground
Vanishing point perspective leading the eye toward the center horizon

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the top 40% of the frame, appearing as a large-scale floating header. The street scene occupies the bottom 60%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white-orange light at the street's vanishing point and the bold typography at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces, move down the perspective lines of the street toward the horizon, and settle on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark sky behind the subjects and the deep black shadows of the parked cars provide breathing room for the saturated highlights.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and midnight blue provide the foundational shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and amber define the street lights, building windows, and ground reflections.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue and violet highlights on the subjects' skin and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast; highlights are near-white/yellow while shadows are crushed black, creating a gritty, cinematic feel.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with wide horizontal proportions
Square-off corners with slight rounding on outer edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first word is significantly larger and all-caps
The second word is lowercase and tucked into the baseline of the first
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and case contrast within a single typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, and bold aesthetic of 90s urban design.
Provides the necessary geometric squareness and horizontal presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a night street scene with long exposure light trails in orange, deep black shadows, and a group of four men in leather jackets and beanies composited into the dark sky area with blue rim lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extended geometric sans-serif text in the bottom left corner using an orange-to-yellow gradient.

verificationChecks: Is the text color sampled from the street lights?
Are the subjects' skin tones reflecting the blue/orange dual lighting?
Is the perspective of the street centered?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the top row
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any existing brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending between the subjects and the dark sky.
Ensure the typography is legible against the street background.
Verify the orange saturation is not clipping into pure red.
Confirm the blue highlights on the subjects are subtle but visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Perspective + Floating Group Header + Dual-Tone High Contrast + Extended Geometric Typography
